_why: Ratchet floors. A gate whose check count can fall silently cannot detect a deleted requirement: stripping four required headings from one pack made validate.py drop 1270->1269 and sloplint.py 224->223, both still green. Each number is the count measured on the commit named below. Raise freely; lowering one needs a reason in the same commit.
_measured_on: a3dfcd4 — main after the T29 fix pass, 2026-08-14, twenty packs, clean tree with no nested worktree
_raised: 2422/1287/504 -> 3222/1811/615 on the proscenium release, 2026-08-17. The jump is one pack plus one kit plus a self-test fixture repair: validate.py gains the twenty-eighth pack's structure, routing, mirror and kit checks, the palette gate gains both theme blocks of a new token layer, and the slop lint gains the pack's prose and its kit CSS. The repair is the informative part -- the core-contract remainder plant matched `The other \w+ answer all four`, which stopped matching the moment the remainder became 'twenty-one', so a plant that changed nothing was reported as a caught defect.
